detail.longDescription: I have a GitHub account and what I am trying to do is to add app-ads.txt file at the root of my <userid>.github.io as requested by admob. Whenever I try to create a new repo, GitHub requires me to provide a repo name and it ends up something like <userid>.github.io/<new_repo_name>. Therefore I can't get to the root folder. I am aware there are other options to get around this problem using other options than GitHub as asked and answered in How to set up app-ads.txt for your apps for Free . I have also read and followed the steps described in Use GitLab/GitHub pages to publish app-ads.txt for Admob . However, after I created the repo, on settings => page I still got myproject.github.io/myproject. Has something changed on GitHub side? Is there a solution for this using GitHub? Or should I head to other sites as proposed in the first question?
